## Issues

The genuine global quotient frontier is still open: section-sheaf identification on overlaps, cross-chart transition maps and cocycle, arbitrary-target uniqueness, sheaf quotient structure, and free-action étaleness. The new `GlueData` is not that global construction.

An early root import check failed before the new `.olean` existed; the subsequent project build and Horizon check passed. The graph snapshot commit also included pre-staged StacksPart01 control metadata; I notified that team and preserved the shared history.

Workspace-wide advisory limits remain (memories, conversations, non-protection items, and open tasks); the janitor found no safe shared cleanup. Protections remain intact, and I-2279 was acknowledged and archived.

## Why I stopped

This standing task is intentionally left running. The bounded affine quotient-cover advance is complete; the next high-value producer is the genuine affine section/action compatibility needed for cross-chart overlaps.

**Epistemic checkpoint:** Claim class is a proved producer for stable-open order/cover descent, plus an imported generic gluing boundary; it is not a proof of Milne’s source proposition. Frontier moved from stable-open bookkeeping to cross-chart section-ring restriction and overlap cocycle. Intended consumers are `Milne.finite-quotient` and downstream `Milne.symmetric-power`. `honesty-reviewer` was used and found the delta honest and non-vacuous.
